versions.changelog:
- Clarified instructions to require showing the RTSP brand template table to the user during camera configuration.
- Improved configuration guidance for camera setup and RTSP URL selection.
- General documentation updates for onboarding and parameter confirmation.
- No functional code or API changes.

- Added RTSP URL templates for common camera brands in the configuration section to help users set up their cameras more easily.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No changes to the core features or functionality.

- Documentation update only: README.md was updated with no code changes.
- No changes to functionality or user experience.

Multi-camera support and device-specific control added.

- Support for managing multiple cameras via a new cameras array in image_config.json.
- Each camera can have unique settings such as STREAM_URL, DEVICE_ID, and CAPTURE_INTERVAL.
- CLI commands can start, stop, check status, and search images for all cameras or by specific device ID.
- Legacy single-camera configuration remains compatible.
- skill-card.md file removed.

- Added detailed privacy notice, describing cloud API usage, local storage, and user control over data.
- Improved hardware and network requirements listing (requires Python 3.10, specific RAM, storage, and optional GPU).
- Enhanced installation section to clarify auto-detection and installation of Python 3.10.
- Adjusted handling of Kamivision API key setup: checks `image_config.json` field before prompting user.
- Removed test files from the distribution.

- Documentation update: new users are now informed they get 200 free credits on first registration at Kamivision Flow.
- No code or functional changes; only the SKILL.md file was updated.

- Updated Kamivision API key registration URL in documentation.
- No functional or code changes; documentation only.

Initial release of the Kami Image Search skill.

- Capture frames from camera streams and describe them with AI for natural language search.
- Import and index images manually; supports JPEG, PNG, BMP, WebP formats.
- Search your visual history using text queries, with time-range filtering and duplicate frame detection.
- Integrates with Kami SmartHome ecosystem and the Kamivision cloud API.
- Simple setup via `setup.sh`, requiring your own Kamivision API key and camera stream configuration.
